Done. Animations added to `slm_alliance.html`, JS parses clean.

What's in:

- **Hero entrance** — eyebrow, headline, paragraph, stats rise/fade in sequence (staggered 0–0.42s, smooth ease-out curve)
- **Ambient motion** — radial glow breathes on 14s loop; background grid drifts slowly (60s) with radial mask fade at edges
- **Stat count-up** — numbers (100, 13, 6) ease up from 0 after hero settles, prefix/suffix (`<`, `M`, `~`, `T`) preserved
- **Scroll reveal** — section headers, mission quote, goals, footer, and every person card fade-rise in on scroll via IntersectionObserver; cards stagger 40ms each, capped so big grid doesn't lag
- **Accent line** — draws outward from center when revealed
- **Hover polish** — person cards lift 4px with soft shadow + avatar scale; mission-goal pills get subtle glow
- **Reduced-motion** — full `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback, everything visible instantly, no JS animations

Kept existing palette/typography — no gradients-everywhere, no bounce, timings restrained so it reads hand-tuned, not template.
